answer: Work history is time-locked and burns when a recruit misbehaves. A bad recruit takes the inviter's last epoch of rewards with it. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so three signatures from one host do not count. Keep the record small: task hash, epoch, signer set. A saffron badge earned this way cannot wander to another account, and a river of clones hits the same lock. Read the signer set before trusting the score.
